title: CORDIAM — Corpus Diacrónico y Diatópico del Español de América
institution: Academia Mexicana de la Lengua (Concepción Company and Virginia Bertolotti, directors; search engine by A. Gelbukh and G. Sidorov)
region: Spanish America (19 countries, plus the US South/West, Jamaica, Haiti, Guyana)
notes: Three subcorpora: Documentos (6,851 texts, archival documents from 'corpus de corpus'), Literatura (6,367; 16th-19th c.) and Prensa (16,271; 18th-19th c. only). The search interface is open without login and full documents are available as per-document PDF files (with a metadata sheet on page 1); the search interface shows concordances and example passages as HTML; there is no bulk download and no TEI. Documents are transcriptions with expanded abbreviations. The countries listed are a selection of the 20+ countries covered. The counts cover the 7,334 documents with a year between 1494 and 1700, and documents dated only by century are not included. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
license_note: Credits page: 'Corpus Cordiam © Concepción Company y Virginia Bertolotti. Buscador © Alexander Gelbukh y Grigori Sidorov'; no open licence on the credits, presentation or citation pages (checked 2026-10-13). Only a citation format is prescribed.
